A '''vidsensor receiver''' was a device that received information from remote [[vidsensor]]s tool used by [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] during field operations. The receiver could receive broadcasts within a two [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] range.
